title: 第1561章 斩司
content_zh:
天空中的华光不断穿梭，片片琉璃般的光彩砸下，与熊熊的真火斗在一块，天空中的咆哮似有似无，如同雷一般淹没在暗沉的光里。
李阙宛抬起手来，将最后一点光彩收入袖中，鼓鼓囊囊的袖口迅速缩紧，她才收起手来，面上的不安淡了一分。
她抬起头来。
天空已经完全暗沉下去，不见日月与天际，只有一片灰色的如布一般的东西，无边无际。
灵识被压制在了体表，动弹不得。
李阙宛庆幸似的吐了口气，默默握紧袖口。
李绛迁与她在小空山的那场对话，稍稍显露了气息，以查幽的本事，自然能看出他在升阳中堆积的种种灵资与法力，以李阙宛的道行，知道这只有一个可能。
李绛迁要用续途妙法了。
可两人身具符种，怎么可能用上续途妙法？兄长虽然一句话也没有说，可其实已经明白的告诉她一件事。
‘要动手了。’
于是李阙宛假意离开此山，进入谷烟大漠，不久立刻折返而回，重新回归小室，稍稍停留，立刻往洛下冲去。
她很明白自己的使命。‘庇护洛下的十数万百姓！’
李遂宁的话很明显，此时此刻只有她有【袖邸之术】这样的手段可以收容十数万人，以及与金一亲近的身份，有可能做到这样一件事！
‘只差一点…哪怕多犹豫一下，这法宝照下来，灵识出不得体表，再也不可能把十数万人精准的收进袖口了…’
此时此刻，她的心已经放下来大半。
‘洛下已经只剩下真人与摩诃，兄长无论做什么…至少不会犯下太大的杀孽…’
可看着那笼罩天际无边无际的暗布，她心中仍然觉得惶恐。
‘这是…阴司第一次…这样在现世这样肆无忌惮的出手…一定有什么超乎了他们的预料…’
女子仅仅犹豫了一瞬，就在漫天穿梭的神通之中踏步向前，更有各色彩和火焰在身边炸开，可天空中的摩诃也好，真人也罢，全都默契地无视了她，任由她在这地界穿梭着。
她一路深入，最后落在了那玄台之上，发觉一切色彩暗沉沉，台上的整个大殿已经消失了。

这座大殿消失的一干两净，不像是被什么巨力拔去的，反而像是从来不存在，高台之上光滑如镜，流淌着赤红色的灵液，在高台边缘，正静静坐着一位青年。
他一身白衣，面容算得上俊俏，却有些许狡诈，似乎被他的到来而惊醒，猛地抬起头来，沙哑地道：
“殿下&183;&183;&183;”
李阙宛只觉得强烈的不安和眩晕冲击着脑海，她往前走了一步，踏进如血一般的灵液里，道：“庞真人&183;&183;&183;我兄长&183;&183;&183;”
庞异有些呆呆地转过头来，那张一向狡诈充满色彩的眼眸，此刻显得无力且惶恐，他只是抬起手来，静静地指了指天际。
他沙哑地道：“在&183;&183;&183;”
“法宝里。”
李阙宛猛地抬起头来，看着天际，往后踉跄了两步，她那张娇美的脸庞一下子雪白，喃喃道：“【九罗得性布】&183;&183;&183;”
庞异点头。
这位野心勃勃，认为自己总能戏耍所有人的青年重新垂下头去，失神一般喃喃道：“我&183;&183;&183;被他骗了&183;&183;&183;他们&183;&183;&183;都被祂骗了&183;&183;&183;哪怕是法相。”
庞异头一次承认自己被另一个人戏耍的如此彻底，可他眼中并没有气急败坏，而是充满着不甘与愤怒，道：“可他&183;&183;&183;也不过是又一个萧初庭&183;&183;&183;”
“轰隆！”
剧烈的声响在远方炸响，似乎有什么光彩正在坠落，李阙宛已经管不了那么多了，他急速转过身去，在滚滚的赤色灵液中踏了两步，略过那在地上昏迷的少年，终于找到了那中年人。
刘长迭正跪在地上。
与其说跪在地上不如说他整个上半身都趴在地面上，只是用双手撑着而已，这位真人剧烈地，仿佛要把肺吐出来一般咳嗽着，大量的淡金色液体从他的唇齿之间淌下，滴落在火中。
李阔宛双眼一下模糊了，她道：“前辈！！”
女子毫不犹豫地跪坐在地上，扶住他，滚滚的、全丹一系的神通法力汹涌而入，修缮着他体内支离破碎的一切，紧接着，大滴大滴的泪就从女子的脸上淌下来。
眼前的男人身上光辉暗淡，只剩下一道色彩。
紫府一神通。
李绛迁当然骗了刘苌迭——李阔宛那次见面根本什么也没给他，从来不存在什么代替神通的灵液，李绛迁夺过了神通而去最后什么也没留下来。

【玄库请凭函】、【齐库两仪珠】、与刘苌迭作为质押的「天齐满」通通一去不复返，作为代价永远沉在了那一玄库处之中。
神通被硬生生拔出，恐怖的创伤和后遗症残留在他体内，淡金色的血不断从他的唇齿之中喷出，前赴后继地落进火里……
过了好一阵，中年人才抬起一只手，抹了抹脸颊。前一刻还是北方各大道统座上宾的刘苌迭，此时此刻，彻底成了一个平庸的、实力不济的寻常紫府一神通。
他道：“绛迁怎么样了？”
李阔宛只觉得一股巨大的悲伤冲上脑海，她动了动双唇，没能说出话来，只是抬起头，望着天空中无边无际的法宝。
两滴泪水从她眼角滑落，女子喃喃道：“前辈&183;&183;&183;”
她泪眼模糊的双眸紧紧望着天际，勾连着那玄妙，试图看清那法宝里的一点点东西，眼前无限的黑暗中，终于浮现出了一点点璀璨的金光那是一位青年。
他悬立在无穷高的天际上，单手持着金枪，斜指地面。
青年的身材挺拔，所披的绛衣早已残破，笼罩了左半边身子，在风中飒飒而动，握着金枪的手粗壮有力，光彩浴之而上，露出右半边赤裸的沾着金血的胸膛。
长眉之下是金色的双眸，冰冷地注视着大地。
李阙宛转过头来，发觉身边的中年人已经站起身来了，他痴痴地望着天际，沙哑的声音轻轻地飘荡：“还不肯罢休&183;&183;&183;”
刘长迭坐在殿中，前后目睹了这一切，心中已经渐渐领悟，他瞳孔中倒映着无限的黑暗，以及被这黑暗阻隔在外的金光&183;&183;&183;
“祂&183;&183;&183;还不肯罢休&183;&183;&183;”
铜门震动&183;&183;&183;
一重重暗色的台阶堆叠，一层层如同瀑布一般的黑气倾泻而下，身后的老人只是平静的站着，一股股阴冷的气息袭来。
杨锐仪有些窒息地站着。
他那双并不锋利，甚至显得柔和的目光痴痴地看着大地，闪动着一重又一重的光彩，同情地凝视着那位绝望的青年。
像是过了极漫长的时间，又像是只过了一瞬，他微微偏过头，好像想说什么。
可身后的冰冷刺骨，那位功曹冷冷的视线像一把剑，直勾勾地盯着他。
杨锐仪把头转回去了，可是他的心剧烈跳动着，胸膛中咚咚直响，仿佛有什么东西不断叩问着他的良心，这位宋朝的大将军，堂堂大真人的骨节终于不允许他这样沉默下去，杨锐仪道：“大人，只怕…不好给麒麟交代。”

身后寂静至极。
杨锐仪没能回头，他稍稍启唇呼吸，好像一只溺水的鱼。
可在他面朝的西方，一片青青之色正在迅速明亮，那处压在重重黑暗中的青宫飞速升起，照耀出万道金光。
站在宫前的公子面对着这重重黑暗没有半分怯场，只是微微低头。
下一瞬，一道冰冷平淡的声音在黑暗中浮现：“够了。”
那站在台阶上的老人终于有了一点点细微的神色波动，祂的双手负在身后，口中发出低笑声：“难得…”
“真君…也管起闲事来了。”
可那滚滚的青金之气，只是在天空中兀自膨胀，如同一道势不可挡的浪潮，从西方汹涌而来，那无上的存在没有与他寒暄，甚至没有回答。
“我说。”
这两个字淡漠无边，倒映在天际之中，于是那黑色开始晃动，隐隐约约又见了日月之光，旋即是平静的低喝：“够了！”
这两个字如同玄光炸碎，隐约看到两金交织，天空中那无边无际，猖狂无度的黑布上终于炸出一片青金色的莲华！
这一切虽然昭昭显现于洛下的每一个人眼中，却仿佛是隔离在九天之外，没有半点声响。
于是天动了。
这一份笼罩天地的灰布仿佛被无上存在吹息而起，密密麻麻的褶皱开始浮现，一道璀璨的金光从正中浮现而出，荡漾出冲天彻地的光色！
阴司镇压江南的【九罗得性布】上，出现了一点金色的，飘飞如蛇的痕迹！
这点痕迹照耀在天际，却好像让太虚和现世都开始震动，一道道无上的目光横扫而过，在无形之中碰撞交汇，最终都凝视在那一点痕迹之上。
于是整片天地开始晃动起来，似乎有星辰的残影在天际浮现，日月之光在裂痕之间交汇，一道又一道的无上身影冲天而起，如同大地上升起的道魅，将整个洛下围得严严实实！
老人仍是负手而立：“恭喜道友…”
他声音平静：“可是…王道友，此刻出手，并非理智之举。”
那青色的宫殿开始震动，里面传来淡淡的笑声，无上的存在开始注视此地，整个洛下的每一寸金石都开始跳动起来，所有的一切都凝固成了雕像。

“杨金新…”
祂道：“再狐假虎威本座会斩破浙南司。”
老人的目光着凝视的西边，倒映出灿烂的金银色，他没有半分恼怒，好像一切行径都是为了逼出此刻，眼中闪过一丝激动与满足，喃喃道：“你拿到了…”
宫阙中没有回答。
取而代之的是一道青光，一道纤如毫毛的青光。
这青光交汇着无数金石交击，火炼真金，雷光乍现乃至于山崩地毁，沙石升腾，百器容蓄的景色，好像收拢了无穷的虚妄，又好似凝结了此间所有的变化。
它是这样的亏损，以至于承载太多，从而显得这样的圆满，两相交移，变化不止，终究在空中交汇，绽放出无穷的玄妙。
“咚！”
天空中的无数阴影如同狂风中的沙砾，在这青光前飘散如烟，似乎有细微的破碎之声，又有哗啦啦的黑暗从天上掉下来，这似乎是一块一块如幕布般的阴影，又像是某个宏伟建筑的一部分。
它们或大或小，如月如星，坠落在地面上，却如同无形之物般毫无阻碍地落下去，深入地底，一直消失在所有人的视野。
“咳咳…”
隐约有剧烈的咳嗽声。
于是黑烟也好，老人也罢，铜门也好，灰布也罢，来自于周围升腾的种种白烟与焰火，都如同泡沫一般破灭。
天地明澈。
天际蓝得如同洗过，月光已经沉入地平线以下，晨曦正在缓缓升起，天空中的残星如同几点银色，洒在日光之下。
洛下一片寂静。
唯一存在天际的，只有那一尊古朴优美的青宫，以及一颗金灿灿的、闪烁的金星。
青金色的云气簇拥着，好似一双环绕天际的臂膀，轻轻包裹着整片洛下，以至于弥漫在北方各处的打斗都显得安宁了，一层层刻满玄妙符文的青阶上，浪荡公子正负手而立，微微垂头俯视。
“够了么&183;&183;&183;”
他沙哑地喃喃着，听着身后的宫阙大门传来细微的挪动声，紧接着传来的是沉重的脚步，天霍转过头去，身后是一位披着青衣的男子。

此人身材修长相貌柔媚，肤若凝脂，身旁环绕着道道银光，两只耳朵略长，透露出几分妖邪来，面上的表情却沉重庄严仿佛在沉思。
天霍轻轻一叹：“李遂宁也是大胆，如此信任他，如今也算不差&183;&183;&183;可你们说要少加伤亡。”
天霍轻声道：“十数位真人，只一死两伤，洛下十数万百姓，更是无一损伤，我家真人挡了酆关，而大人亲自出手，先挡法相，后拒阴司…”
他轻声道：“若非大人在此，檀主岂能罢休？就算是阴司收走九罗得性布而不理，祂也一定会出手。”青年男子仍然沉默。
天霍似乎知道他在想什么，这公子站起身，微微叹了口气，负手而立，面对那万里天光下的灿灿金地，万众瞩目中，他轻声道：“这是大争，不是儿戏，该死的人死了，不该死的人未死，我们亦有我们的使命……听府道友，金一已经让得够多了。”
content_en:
The brilliance in the sky continued to shuttle, and pieces of glass-like brilliance fell down, fighting with the blazing real fire. The roar in the sky seemed to be absent, like thunder, submerged in the dark light.
Li Quewan raised her hand and put the last bit of brilliance into her sleeves. The bulging cuffs quickly tightened, and then she closed her hands, and the uneasiness on her face faded away.
She looked up.
The sky has completely darkened, and there is no sun, moon, or horizon. There is only a gray cloth-like thing, boundless.
The spiritual consciousness was suppressed on the surface of the body and could not move.
Li Quewan breathed out a breath of joy and silently clenched his cuffs.
The conversation between Li Jiangqian and her in Xiaokong Mountain revealed a little bit. With Cha You's ability, he could naturally see the various spiritual resources and mana he had accumulated in the rising sun. With Li Quewan's Taoism, he knew that this was only a possibility.
Li Jiangqian is going to use the magic method of continuing the journey.
But two people possessing talismans, how could they use the magic method to continue their journey? Although her brother didn't say a word, he actually told her one thing clearly.
‘It’s time to take action. ’
So Li Quewan pretended to leave the mountain and entered the Guyan Desert. Soon he turned back, returned to the small room, stayed for a while, and immediately rushed to Luoxia.
She clearly understands her mission. ‘Protect hundreds of thousands of people in Luoxia! ’
Li Suining's words make it obvious that at this moment, she is the only one who has the ability to contain hundreds of thousands of people, and is close to Jin Yi, so it is possible for her to do such a thing!
'It's just a little bit worse... Even if you hesitate a little longer, your spiritual sense will not be able to detect the physical appearance of this magic weapon, and it will no longer be possible to accurately put hundreds of thousands of people into your sleeves...'
At this moment, she was mostly relieved.
"Only Zhenren and Maha are left in Luoxia. No matter what brother does... at least he won't commit too big a crime..."
But looking at the endless dark cloth covering the sky, she still felt terrified in her heart.
'This is... the first time that Yinsi... has acted so unscrupulously in this world... there must be something beyond their expectations...'
The woman only hesitated for a moment, and then stepped forward amidst the magical powers that filled the sky, and various colors and flames exploded around her. However, whether it was Maha in the sky or a real person, they all ignored her tacitly and allowed her to shuttle through the earth.
She went all the way deep and finally landed on the Xuantai. She found that everything was dark and the entire hall on the platform had disappeared.
This hall disappeared completely. It didn't seem like it was pulled out by some huge force, but it seemed like it had never existed. The high platform was as smooth as a mirror, with red spiritual fluid flowing. On the edge of the high platform, a young man was sitting quietly.
He was dressed in white, and his face could be considered handsome, but a little cunning. He seemed to be awakened by his arrival. He suddenly raised his head and said hoarsely:
"Your Highness&183;&183;&183;"
Li Quewan only felt strong uneasiness and dizziness hitting her mind. She took a step forward, stepped into the blood-like spiritual liquid, and said: "Zhenren Pang...my brother..."
Pang Yi turned his head blankly, his eyes that were always cunning and full of color looked weak and frightened at the moment. He just raised his hand and pointed to the sky quietly.
He said hoarsely: "In&183;&183;&183;"
"In the magic weapon."
Li Quewan suddenly raised her head, looked at the sky, stumbled back two steps, her beautiful face suddenly turned white, and murmured: "[Jiu Luo De Xing Cloth]&183;&183;&183;"
Pang Yi nodded.
This man is ambitious and thinks he can always play tricks on everyone.Someone's young man lowered his head again and murmured in a daze: "I was deceived by him, they were all deceived by him, even if it was the Dharma image."
Pang Yi admitted for the first time that he had been played so thoroughly by another person, but his eyes were not angry, but full of unwillingness and anger, saying: "But he's just another Xiao Chuting'183;&183;&183;"
"Boom!"
A violent sound exploded in the distance, and it seemed that some kind of brilliance was falling. Li Quewan could no longer care so much. He turned around quickly, took two steps in the rolling red spiritual liquid, passed the unconscious young man on the ground, and finally found the middle-aged man.
Liu Changdie was kneeling on the ground.
Rather than kneeling on the ground, it would be better to say that his entire upper body was lying on the ground, just supported by his hands. This real person coughed violently, as if he wanted to spit out his lungs, and a large amount of pale golden liquid dripped from between his lips and teeth, dripping into the fire.
Li Kuowan's eyes suddenly blurred, and she said: "Senior!!"
The woman knelt down on the ground without hesitation and supported him. The rolling magical power of the whole elixir system surged in, repairing everything that was broken in his body. Then, big tears fell down from the woman's face.
The light on the man in front of him was dim, leaving only a streak of color.
Zifu has a magical power.
Of course Li Jiangqian deceived Liu Changdie - Li Kuowan gave him nothing at all during that meeting. There was never any spiritual liquid that could replace the magical power. Li Jiangqian took away the magical power and left nothing behind.
[Letter from Xuanku], [Qiku Liangyi Pearl], and "Tian Qiman" that were pledged by Liu Changde were all gone forever, and as a price they were forever buried in that Xuanku.
The magical power was forcibly pulled out, and the horrific trauma and sequelae remained in his body. Light golden blood kept spurting out from his lips and teeth, and fell into the fire one after another...
After a while, the middle-aged man raised a hand and wiped his cheek. Liu Changdie, who a moment ago was a guest of honor at all the major avenues in the north, at this moment, has completely become a mediocre, weak and ordinary Zifu magic power.
He asked: "How is Jiang Qian?"
Li Kuowan felt a huge sadness rushing into her mind. She moved her lips but could not speak. She just raised her head and looked at the boundless magic weapon in the sky.
Two tears fell from the corners of her eyes, and the woman murmured: "Senior&183;&183;&183;"
Her tear-filled eyes stared at the sky, connected to the mystery, trying to see a little bit of the magic weapon. In the infinite darkness in front of her, a little bright golden light finally appeared. It was a young man.
He was hanging in the infinite sky, holding a golden gun in one hand and pointing diagonally at the ground.
The young man has a tall and straight figure, and the crimson clothes he wears are already torn, covering the left half of his body, rustling in the wind. The hand holding the golden gun is thick and powerful, and the light shines on it, revealing the right half of his naked chest stained with golden blood.
Under the long eyebrows are golden eyes, staring coldly at the earth.
Li Quewan turned his head and found that the middle-aged man beside him had stood up. He looked at the sky dreamily, and his hoarse voice floated softly: "I still refuse to give up..."
Liu Changdie was sitting in the palace and witnessed all this.He has gradually realized in his heart that the infinite darkness is reflected in his pupils, and the golden light blocked by this darkness&183;&183;&183;
"He&183;&183;&183;will not give up yet&183;&183;&183;"
The copper door vibrates&183;&183;&183;
There were layers of dark steps stacked on top of each other, and layers of black air poured down like waterfalls. The old man behind him just stood calmly, and waves of cold air came over him.
Yang Ruiyi stood suffocated.
His eyes, which were not sharp and even seemed soft, looked at the earth with a dull look, flashing with brilliance one after another, gazing sympathetically at the desperate young man.
It seemed like an extremely long time had passed, yet it seemed like only a moment had passed. He tilted his head slightly, as if he wanted to say something.
But the coldness behind him was biting, and the meritorious master's cold gaze was like a sword, staring straight at him.
Yang Ruiyi turned his head back, but his heart was beating violently, and there was a thumping sound in his chest, as if something kept asking his conscience. The bones of this great general of the Song Dynasty, a dignified real person, finally did not allow him to remain silent like this. Yang Ruiyi said: "My lord, I'm afraid...it's hard to explain to Qilin."
There was extreme silence behind him.
Yang Ruiyi couldn't look back. He opened his lips slightly to breathe, like a drowning fish.
But in the west he was facing, a green color was rapidly brightening, and the Qing Palace that was buried in darkness rose rapidly, shining out thousands of golden lights.
The young master standing in front of the palace did not have any stage fright in the face of this heavy darkness, but just lowered his head slightly.
The next moment, a cold and plain voice emerged in the darkness: "That's enough."
The old man standing on the steps finally had a slight change in his expression. He put his hands behind his back and chuckled: "It's rare..."
"Zhenjun...has also started to mind his own business."
But the billowing green gold energy just continued to expand in the sky, like an unstoppable wave, surging from the west. The supreme being did not greet him or even answer.
"I said."
These two words were indifferent and boundless, reflected in the sky, and then the black began to shake, and the light of the sun and the moon was faintly visible again, and then he calmly shouted: "Enough!"
These two words were like Xuan Guang exploding into pieces, and the two golds were vaguely intertwined. A green-gold lotus finally exploded out of the boundless and unbridled black cloth in the sky!
Although all this clearly appeared in the eyes of everyone in Luoxia, it seemed to be isolated nine days away without any sound.
Then the sky moved.
The gray cloth covering the world seemed to be blown up by the supreme being, and dense folds began to emerge. A bright golden light emerged from the center, rippling out a light that reached the sky and the earth!
On the [Jiu Luo De Xing Cloth] used by the Yin Division to suppress Jiangnan, there were traces of gold, flying like snakes!
This trace shines in the sky, but it seems to make Taixu and the present world start to shake. One after another, the supreme gaze sweeps across, colliding and intersecting invisibly, and finally stares at that trace.
Then the whole world began to shake, as if the afterimages of stars were emerging in the sky. The light of the sun and the moon met between the cracks. One after another, the supreme figures rose into the sky, like Tao charms rising from the earth, tightly surrounding the entire Luoxia!
The old man still stood with his hands behind his hands: "Congratulations, fellow Taoist..."
His voice was calm: "But... Fellow Daoist Wang, taking action at this moment is not a rational move."
The blue palace began to shake, and a faint laughter came from inside. The supreme existence began to look at this place. Every inch of gold and stone in Luoxia began to beat, and everything solidified intostatue.
"Yang Jinxin..."
He said: "If you pretend to be a tiger again, I will defeat the Southern Zhejiang Province."
The old man's eyes were staring at the west, reflecting the brilliant gold and silver. He was not angry at all, as if all his actions were to force him to appear at this moment. A trace of excitement and satisfaction flashed in his eyes, and he murmured: "You got it..."
There was no answer in the palace.
It was replaced by a green light, a green light as thin as a hair.
This blue light intersects with countless gold and stones, fire refines real gold, thunder suddenly appears, causing landslides and ground destruction, sand and stones rise, and the scenery of hundreds of weapons seems to have gathered infinite illusions, and it seems to have condensed all the changes here.
It is such a loss that it carries too much, so it appears to be so perfect. The two phases alternate and change, and finally meet in the air, blooming into infinite mystery.
"Boom!"
Countless shadows in the sky were like gravel in the strong wind, floating like smoke in front of the blue light. There seemed to be a slight breaking sound, and there was a crash of darkness falling from the sky. These seemed to be shadows like curtains, and they seemed to be part of some magnificent building.
They are big or small, like the moon or stars, they fall to the ground, but like invisible objects they fall without any hindrance, go deep into the ground, and disappear from everyone's sight.
"Ahem..."
There was a faint sound of violent coughing.
So the black smoke, the old man, the bronze door, the gray cloth, all the white smoke and fireworks rising from the surroundings burst like bubbles.
Heaven and earth are clear.
The sky is as blue as washed, the moonlight has sunk below the horizon, the morning light is rising slowly, and the remaining stars in the sky are like a few silver dots, shining under the sunlight.
There was silence in Luoxia.
The only thing that exists in the sky is the simple and beautiful Qing Palace and a shining golden star.
Green-gold clouds surrounded the sky, like a pair of arms encircling the sky, gently wrapping the entire Luoxia, so that the fighting everywhere in the north seemed peaceful. On the green steps engraved with mysterious runes, the prodigal son stood with his hands behind his back, looking down slightly.
“Is that enough&183;&183;&183;”
He murmured hoarsely, listening to the slight sound of movement from the palace gate behind him, followed by heavy footsteps. Tianhuo turned his head, and behind him was a man in green clothes.
This person has a slender figure and a soft appearance, with skin as smooth as gel. He is surrounded by silver light. His ears are slightly longer, revealing a bit of evil, but the expression on his face is heavy and solemn, as if he is deep in thought.
Tianhuo sighed softly: "Li Suining is also bold, trusting him so much, it's not bad now...but you said you want to reduce casualties."
Tianhuo said softly: "Of the dozens of real people, only one died and two were injured, and among the tens of thousands of people in Luoxia, not a single one was injured. My real people blocked Fengguan, and you personally took action, first blocking the Dharma, and then rejecting the Yin Division..."
He said softly: "If you weren't here, how could Master Tan give up? Even if the Yins take away Jiu Luo De Xing Bu and ignore it, he will definitely take action." The young man remained silent.
Tianhuo seemed to know what he was thinking. The young master stood up, sighed slightly, and stood with his hands behind his back. Facing the golden land under the thousands of miles of sky, with everyone watching, he said softly: "This is a big fight, not a child's play. Those who deserve to die are dead, and those who don't deserve to die are not dead. We also have our mission... Fellow Taoist Master, Jin Yi has given in enough."
